notes: Customer: mid-market product company building a user-facing AI assistant + semantic search across docs.
Primary ask: start on Hosted for quick iteration then move to Dedicated once steady traffic (~Q2 ramp).
Latency requirement: conversational p95 target ~200-250ms; embeddings throughput 500 reqs/min steady with spikes.
Cost sensitivity: wants predictable committed spend; CFO requires clear ramp + overage caps. 'Need >75% price certainty for FY26' (quote).
Security: VPC + customer-managed KMS required for Dedicated; retention controls and audit logs mandatory.
Technical: already tested Redwood hosted API in POC; saw 25% lower token cost vs competitor X at baseline but needs better SLA for peak traffic.

requirements_summary: Workloads: chat + assistant (low-latency), embeddings for semantic search, reranking for results ordering.
Throughput/latency: chat p95 target 200-250ms; embeddings 500 qps burst to 2k for reindex windows.
Model preferences: prefers curated open models; evaluates smaller quantized variants for embeddings + L2 reranking.
Routing/fallback: wants automatic fallback to smaller model during infra maintenance and region-based routing.
Compliance: SOC2 required; SSO for internal users; audit logs retained 12 months; ability to pin region (US-East).
deal_terms_discussed: Initial commit proposal: 200M tokens/month reserved for Dedicated (baseline), 12-month term.
Burst: 2x burst buffer available for short spikes (up to 30 minutes/session), charged at discounted burst rate.
Overage: capped overage rate negotiated at $0.00045/token (tiered after 120% of commit), with quarterly true-up.
Ramp schedule: 3-month phased ramp to reach full commit (50% month1, 80% month2, 100% month3); credit back for unused ramp capacity.
Pricing: 18% discount over hosted list for committed volume; additional 5% for annual prepay.
SLAs: targeted p99 latency SLOs for dedicated pool; service credit language to be added to SOW.
Support: Standard enterprise support included; optional premium on-call for first 90 days of Dedicated rollout.
